links.passage: Comparatively to the traditional irrigation advisory services, the satellite-based systems have the advantage of reflecting the actual conditions of the canopy over a spatially and temporally distributed frame, covering large areas and providing within-field heterogeneity information, and fostering a more efficient use of water for irrigation by allowing tailored recommendations per individual plot and a timely delivery of information (Calera et al., 2017; Calera Belmonte et al., 2005; Vuolo et al., 2015a).
links.citation_in_text: Calera et al., 2017; Calera Belmonte et al., 2005; Vuolo et al., 2015a
